No cast shadows, ambient occlusion, darkened undersides, directional shading, strong highlights, reflections, rim lighting, exterior glow or bloom. Paint luminous crystal veins as fine bright blue-white colour ONLY inside the silhouette, with restrained brightness. Facets may have subtle inherent blue colour variation but no lighting gradient. Faint metal sheen only, no white metallic glare. All reference seams and wear are surface marks; no new geometry.
